_README: Migrations that are written but NOT YET RUN in production.
A new function migration is not drift 2014 it is a known window between writing
it and running it. Without this file check-schema-drift goes red on a correct
commit, and a gate that is red when nothing is wrong gets ignored.
THIS FILE CANNOT BECOME A SILENCER. It is self-clearing: the moment a
declared migration's functions appear in schema-index.json, the entry is
stale and the gate FAILS until it is deleted. An entry naming a file with no
CREATE FUNCTION also fails. So a declaration buys the deploy window and
